kpi_definitions.name: Exception rate
kpi_definitions.aggregation_rule: Ratio of sums; n/a when volume = 0. Severity filter narrows the numerator only

kpi_definitions.name: On-time completion %
kpi_definitions.definition: sum(completed_on_time) / sum(transaction_volume), both de-duplicated at process-month
kpi_definitions.aggregation_rule: Ratio of sums; unaffected by severity filter

kpi_definitions.name: High-severity exceptions
kpi_definitions.definition: sum(exceptions) where severity in High, Critical

kpi_definitions.name: Open exceptions
kpi_definitions.definition: sum(exceptions) where remediation_status != Closed, in the latest month of the period
kpi_definitions.aggregation_rule: Point in time (latest month), not summed over months

kpi_definitions.name: Open exceptions by ageing band
kpi_definitions.aggregation_rule: Unknown band shown when ageing_days is blank

kpi_definitions.name: Remediation closure rate
kpi_definitions.definition: Closed exceptions / all exceptions in the period

kpi_definitions.name: Month-over-month movement
kpi_definitions.definition: Exception rate latest month minus prior month

kpi_definitions.name: Data quality completeness
kpi_definitions.definition: Non-blank optional cells / all optional cells; plus share of rows flagged Pass
